Emit an optimix result as an orchestra manifest

Source: R/manifest.R
as_orchestra_manifest.Rd

The federation's emit / adapt generic. The optimix_result method turns an optimisation result into the shared orchestra_manifest contract: inferential_target = "parameters", the optimum carried as a one-row params table (the best parameter vector and its objective value), and the engine provenance – which optimiser ran, why it was chosen, convergence, the true evaluation count, and whether an uncertainty quantification is available – in the typed summary and metadata. When the proxymix mixture engine ran, metadata$solution_map carries the queryable mixture over all optima, so a downstream consumer that needs a posterior over the optimum (not just a point) can read it; a point engine sets metadata$uncertainty_available = FALSE. The payload is integrity-hashed so a consumer can verify it with verify_manifest().

Usage

as_orchestra_manifest(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'optimix_result'
as_orchestra_manifest(x, ..., run_id = NULL, seed = NA_integer_)

Arguments

x

An optimix_result object.

...

Further arguments passed to methods.

run_id

Optional character run identifier; a content hash is derived when omitted, so two identical optima get the same identifier.

seed

Optional integer recorded for reproducibility.

Value

An orchestra_manifest S7 object.

See also

verify_manifest(), optimix()

Other orchestra manifest: orchestra_manifest(), verify_manifest()

Examples

res <- optimix(function(x) sum((x - 0.5)^2), c(-2, -2), c(2, 2),
               method = "base_optim")
as_orchestra_manifest(res)
#> <orchestra_manifest>

#>  @ emitter_version   : chr "0.2.0.9000"
